answer: We design a Sybil-resistant mechanism using dynamic opportunity-cost bonds and subgame-perfect slashing matrices, where staking collateral secured via zero-knowledge verifiable delay enforces strict identity costs. This capital barrier guarantees that multiplying identities yields strictly negative expected attack utility, proving any adversarial summit ascent cannot exploit the juniper oasis of forged nodes to evade slashing. Such primitives induce robust Nash equilibrium convergence, forcing rational agents to abandon Sybil multiplication wholly.
